name: Joseph Cin
headline: I turn messy data into decisions, and I build the tools around it.
intro: Information Science grad from the University of Maryland. I work across the whole path: collecting and cleaning data, modeling it, and shipping it as something people can actually use.
openTo: Open to data analyst and data engineering roles.
about: I graduated from the University of Maryland, College Park with a B.S. in Information Science, after an A.S. in Computer Science from Frederick Community College.

My favorite projects sit where analysis meets product: a model is only useful if someone can act on it, so I tend to build the interface too. Outside of work I'm learning to cook, reading novels like Lord of the Mysteries, and playing intramural volleyball and basketball.
I'm bilingual in English and Sizang.
